steps.title: 01-signin: Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8090/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given, including the braces). After signing in, confirm success by reporting the username shown in the top-right user menu or the home page.

02-open: In {{01-signin.page_title}}, open the project named 'Bench Project' and go to its work packages list. Find all work packages whose subject starts with the text 'Seed:' and report each subject EXACTLY as displayed, one per line, with no other work packages included. Do not modify anything. Report the full list of matching subjects.

03-create: In {{01-signin.page_title}}, in the project 'Bench Project', create a new work package of type 'Task' with the subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench work package for run {{runid}}'). Save it. Then report the work package's numeric ID as displayed ({{01-signin.page_title}} shows it like #123), its subject, and confirm the description text saved.

04-open: In {{01-signin.page_title}}, open work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project'. Edit the Assignee field in place: click it, type 'Bench Assignee' into the autocomplete, wait for the dropdown of matching users, and actually SELECT the 'Bench Assignee' option from the dropdown (typing alone does not count). Let it save. Then report the value now displayed in the Assignee field on the page.

05-open: In {{01-signin.page_title}}, open work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project'. Change its Status to 'In progress' by editing the status field in place (click it, choose 'In progress' from the dropdown, let it save). Then report the status value now displayed on the work package page.

06-open: In {{01-signin.page_title}}, open work package {{03-create.work_package_id}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project 'Bench Project'. Set its Finish date to 2026-12-31 by editing the finish date field in place (click it, enter the date 12/31/2026 or 2026-12-31 as the app expects, let it save). Then report the finish date value now displayed on the work package page, exactly as shown.
